description: Render watermarked PNG preview(s) of a VALID design (all zones, or one via zoneId). Returns preview image URLs plus the watermarked preview as inline image content (one per zone) - show it to the user. If the render queue is busy it returns {status:"pending", retryAfterSec} - retry after that delay.

zoneId.description: Render a single zone; omit to render all zones.

name: render_preview
